title: PCR Partial Control Region Amplification and Sequencing
author: Sebastian Poljak
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kmncu5e

steps.title: Extract DNA
steps.instruction: Extract DNA from the sample source using the appropriate method.

substeps.instruction: For fixed or dried tissues (liver, spleen, muscle, and skin), use the sodium dodecyl sulphate–proteinase K/phenol/RNAse method.
For blood, follow the method by John et al. (1991).

steps.title: Prepare PCR Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a 25 ul volume PCR mix with the following components:

substeps.instruction: 2.5 ul of 10 x Taq polymerase buffer

steps.title: Amplify DNA
steps.instruction: Perform amplification in a Biometra T Personal thermocycler using the following thermal profile:

substeps.instruction: 35 cycles of: 94 ºC for 30 s, 56 ºC for 30 s, and 72 ºC for 45 s

steps.title: Purify and Concentrate PCR Products
steps.instruction: Purify the double-stranded PCR products and concentrate them via ethanol precipitation.

steps.title: Verify and Sequence Products
steps.instruction: Verify the products and perform sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Sequence directly in both directions using the same primers used for amplification.
Conduct sequencing using an ABI PRISM 3130 XL automated sequencer (Applied Biosystems™).

steps.title: Edit and Align Sequences
steps.instruction: Process the resulting sequences using software.

substeps.instruction: Align sequences using the CLUSTAL W software package.
